name: com.xenmcp/docker-agent
title: XenMCP Docker agent
description: Read-only MCP server for one Docker host: containers, inspect, logs, stats, events. No exec.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer and the key set in XENMCP_AGENT_KEY

environmentVariables.name: XENMCP_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key callers must send as Authorization: Bearer (at least 32 characters)

environmentVariables.name: XENMCP_ALLOW_IPS
environmentVariables.description: Addresses or CIDRs allowed to call the agent, comma-separated (default: XenMCP's address)
